activity.notes: The Oxford Classical Dictionary places Diogenes' exile from Sinope sometime after 362 BCE and his remaining life in Athens and Corinth, with death dated approximately 324/321 BCE. ATLAS therefore records a deliberately approximate post-exile intellectual-activity envelope. Athens is a representative locus within an Athens-and-Corinth phase, not a claim of exclusive continuous residence; later anecdotal stories are not used to sharpen the chronology.
